 Montgomery County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0006
 Justin Anderson, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Plaintiff's Original Petition
Filed:
July 23, 2024
Plaintiff's counsel:
Kyle Sanders, Marshall & Dominguez LLP
PARTIES
Plaintiff Justin Anderson is an individual residing in Texas who was the driver of the vehicle involved in the collision described
below. Defendant is an automobile insurance company authorized to do business in the State of Texas, which issued the liability
and uninsured/underinsured motorist coverage under which Plaintiff now seeks recovery.
FACTS
On August 13, 2023, Plaintiff was lawfully stopped in traffic on a public roadway in League City, Texas, waiting for the vehicle
ahead to proceed. A third-party driver operating a vehicle behind Plaintiff failed to stop and struck the rear of Plaintiff's vehicle at
a substantial rate of speed. The impact drove Plaintiff's vehicle forward and jolted Plaintiff's body violently against the seat and
restraint system. Plaintiff's vehicle sustained structural and cosmetic damage, and Plaintiff was unable to drive it from the scene.
Plaintiff timely reported the collision and submitted a claim for benefits under the policy in force at the time of the loss.
NEGLIGENCE
The at-fault drievr owed a duty to mainatin a proper lookout, control speed, and keep a safe distance from vehicles ahead, and
breached that duty by failing to do so. Defendant, as the insurer, owed Plaintiff a duty of good faith and fair dealing and a duty to
promptly and reasonably investigate and resolve covered claims under the Texas Insurance Code. Defendant has failed to pay the
benefits due under the policy within the time required by statute, and its handling of the claim has been unreasonable under the
circumstances.
DAMAGES
As a direct result of the collision, Plaintiff suffered a serious shoulder injury requiring medical evaluation, imaging, and ongoing
treatment. Plaintiff has incurred medical expenses, lost wages, and loss of use and enjoyment of daily activities, and expects to
incur future care. Plaintiff seeks recovery of all benefits owed under the policy, statutory interest, attorney's fees, and court costs,
and demands damages in the amount of $220,000.00.
